name: safari
title: Safari Browser Mockup
description: A browser window drawn in SVG, with traffic-light dots, back and forward arrows, a URL field and toolbar icons, sized to wrap a screenshot or a looping video as its page.
use: A product shot or screenshot should look like it is running inside a real browser window.
avoid: Small thumbnails, where the toolbar details blur into grey, or when a plain screenshot is enough.
a11y: The screen image has empty alt and the toolbar glyphs are unlabelled SVG paths, so they are noise to a screen reader. (keyboard: n-a, labels: partial, reduced motion: not handled)
looks: A wide window with rounded top corners sits on black. Its dark toolbar holds three grey dots at the left, two arrow glyphs, a rounded address pill with a small lock and URL, and share, add-tab and tab icons at the right. Below, a photo fills the screen area down to the rounded bottom.
behaves: Static in the frames: the window does nothing on its own. It stretches to the width it is given while keeping its aspect ratio, and if a video is supplied it plays that on a loop behind the chrome instead of a still.
customise: Swap the image or video and the URL text by props; the mode switches the full toolbar for a bare frame, while window colours and proportions live in the SVG.
weight: light: One inline SVG plus a single image or video, with no scripted animation.
demo: An address bar reading example.com above a photo of a man holding a small workshop tool
issues: The toolbar icons and address text are very faint grey at this width and barely resolve.
polishWhy: Convincing proportions and a tidy window; the tiny grey toolbar detail gets lost.
